interface.signature: def doctorStrange(N: int, M: int, graph: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of sanctums (N) and bridges (M) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: Each edge in the graph connects two valid sanctum nodes (1 ≤ u, v ≤ N).
The graph contains exactly M edges.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in range(1, N + 1) if not is_articulation_point(N, graph, node))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of sanctums whose removal disconnects the graph, where `is_articulation_point` is a helper that checks if removing the node disconnects the graph (i.e., it is an articulation point).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= node <= N for node in range(1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: The check for articulation points is performed for every valid sanctum node (1 to N).
